citations.assessment: The exact Simai teaching concerns Israel putting “we will do” before “we will hear.” It occurs in the chapter Rabbi Akiva on 88a.
The baraita explicitly attributes the resurrection proof to R. Simai.
R. Elazar teaches in R. Simai’s name about God repaying Avraham’s hospitality.
The witness explicitly gives Elazar bar Rabbi Simai and includes the bread and water rewards. For this local comparison, preserve the father form and the printed shorter spelling separately.
The exact parallel about recompense to Avraham’s descendants is present. This digital witness gives Elazar bar Rabbi Ḥiyya, while Heilprin reports Ḥayyim and proposes the wording in Bereshit Rabbah.
The exact saying concerns Aharon and his sons. The checked text spells the name סימאי, compared with Heilprin’s סימאיי.
The Ḥelbo entry contains the exact chain from R. Ḥiyya in Simai’s name. The received Yerushalmi puts this at 1:5:14, with an alternate transmission through the colleagues.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: Ḥiyya bar Abba gives Simai’s saying about Bilam, Iyov and Yitro.
Sotah repeats the named chain and its three counselors.
Yonatan specifically asks Simai about muzzling an ox outside the place of threshing.
The passage attributes the intercalation testimony about both Adars to Simai in the names of the three prophets, in Rav Naḥman bar Ḥisda’s exposition.
The Bavli has Simai and Tzadok in Lod and reports a specific perforation condition of the crop. It says they went to intercalate a year, whereas the root gives the plural.
